botIdentity.title: Bot identity
botIdentity.none: No bot hits received yet. They need plugin 1.5.0 or later, with traffic capture on and the plugin connected.
botIdentity.observedNote: Verified: the request's IP is in the operator's published list (OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, Google), or Google's reverse DNS confirms it.
botIdentity.heuristicNote: User agent only: the request says it is this bot, but its IP is not in the published list, so the IP was deleted right after the check (it may be a person using the name).
botIdentity.minimum: Last {days} days. Pages served from a host or CDN cache never reach WordPress, so these counts are a minimum.

generators.title: Fix generators
generators.sub: Built from your store's own data. Copy them; AgentScope changes nothing on the store.
generators.editorsOnly: Only owners and admins can use the generators.
generators.noKey: No API key is saved for this store, so its data cannot be read.
generators.robotsIntro: Your current robots.txt with the AI agents' rules rewritten. Search and shopping agents are allowed; your other rules, sitemaps and other bots stay as they are. Pages you closed for all bots ("*") stay closed for the AI agents too.
generators.robotsUnchanged: Your robots.txt already does this. Nothing to change.
generators.robotsValid: Checked with the scan's own parser: {n} bot and page verdicts as intended, other bots unchanged.
generators.robotsInvalid: Check failed, do not use this file: {problems}
generators.wpHow: How to change robots.txt on WordPress
generators.wp1: If a robots.txt file exists in your site's root folder (hosting file manager or FTP), replace its content.
generators.wp2: Yoast SEO: Yoast SEO → Tools → File editor. Rank Math: Rank Math → General Settings → Edit robots.txt.
generators.wp3: Without a file or SEO plugin, WordPress serves a virtual robots.txt: create the file in the root folder with this content.
generators.wp4: Clear the site and CDN cache, open /robots.txt in a browser to check, then run a new scan.
generators.wafIntro: Guidance to copy, from what the last scan saw. Protection detected: {vendor}.
generators.wafLists: Official IP lists to allow by (a user agent alone can be faked):
generators.llmsIntro: A summary of your store for AI tools, written only from your store's data: title, tagline, shop page, categories, products and policy pages. Nothing is invented.
generators.llmsMissing: Missing in your store, so left out: {list}.
generators.llmsHow: Upload it as {url} (site root, hosting file manager or FTP), then run a new scan.

fixCenter.generatorsNote: robots.txt patch, firewall guidance and llms.txt, from your store's data.
fixCenter.rechecksNote: After a fix is verified, AI Visibility runs again 7, 14 and 30 days later. They show what the models answered on those days; they do not prove the fix changed anything, and an immediate re-check never does.
fixCenter.formula: How the order is computed (weights you can change)
fixCenter.formulaNote: Priority = (Impact × Confidence) ÷ Effort. Impact = severity weight, × store-wide factor when it affects the whole store. Confidence: Observed 1.0, Heuristic 0.5 by default. Effort: 1 a setting or a copied file, 2 content in the store, 3 a developer or host change. Unavailable findings are not ranked: they need a check first.
fixCenter.checkNote: These could not be checked, so they are not ranked. The evidence says why.

autofix.title: Auto-fix technical issues
autofix.intro: When on, each scan applies the technical fixes that need no business decision (llms.txt, robots.txt groups for AI search agents, the store's name as brand when a product has none), checks each one, logs it, and lets you undo it in one click. Prices, images, weights and barcodes are never filled in for you.
autofix.nothing: Nothing to change right now; later scans will apply new technical fixes.
autofix.previewNote: One approval covers this and the same kinds of fixes on later scans. Each change is logged with its previous value, so it can be undone.
autofix.enabledNow: Auto-fix is on. {n} fixes applied now.
autofix.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
autofix.autoNote: Applied by auto-fix (technical, from your store's data).
autofix.explain_sell_where_ship: Your store sells to all countries but ships only to some. This sets the selling locations to the countries of your shipping zones, so nobody can order where you cannot deliver.
autofix.explain_guest_checkout: Lets buyers (and agents buying for them) check out without creating an account.
autofix.explain_price: Only you know the price. It is written to the product as you type it.
autofix.explain_image: Paste the link of a real photo of this product (https, JPG/PNG/WebP).
autofix.explain_weight: The shipping weight, in the store's weight unit.
autofix.explain_gtin: The product's barcode (EAN/UPC), only if it has one. It is checked before saving.
autofix.confirm_sell_where_ship: Set the selling locations to the countries you ship to? You can undo it from the audit log.
autofix.confirm_guest_checkout: Turn on guest checkout? You can undo it from the audit log.
autofix.v_still_open: re-check still finds it (cache can take a moment)
autofix.writeKeyAdd: Add a write key (for one-click and input fixes)
autofix.writeKeyIntro: A second WooCommerce key with Read/Write permission (WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API). It is kept apart from the read key, encrypted, and used only for the fixes you approve. It is checked by writing the store address back unchanged.

outcome.title: After your fixes
outcome.note: What the models returned before a verified fix compared with the re-checks 7, 14 and 30 days later, on the same questions and engines. Only questions answered both times count. Model answers vary between runs and ungrounded models do not read your store live, so a change is not proof that the fix caused it. It does not predict rankings or sales.
outcome.noChange: No change in the compared answers
outcome.noBaseline: No AI Visibility run before the fix, so there is nothing to compare with.
outcome.noOverlap: No question was answered both before the fix and on the re-check.

landing.metaTitle: AgentScope: why AI shopping agents skip your WooCommerce products
landing.hero: See why AI shopping agents skip your WooCommerce products. Fix without breaking the store. Prove it with real AI-referred orders.
landing.edge: Others give you a score. We show why AI agents don't buy, fix it, and prove it with real orders.
landing.pointsTitle: Why stores and agencies use it

multi.d: Client workspaces, team members with roles, and read-only report links with your name on them.

bots.d: Visits from AI bots checked against the official IP lists of each AI company. A user agent alone is labeled as a claim, not a fact.

check.d: Paste a store address: no account, no key. A few public pages, loaded slowly and politely, like a visitor would.

noScore.d: No single number that hides the reasons. Each finding says what was seen, where, and how sure we are.

landing.stepsTitle: See it. Fix it. Prove it.

see.d: Every product checked: price, stock, weight, images, brand, GTIN, structured data and the ChatGPT feed fields. Bot access, robots.txt, checkout rules and where the path to a purchase breaks first.

fix.d: Read-only by default. Each change is shown before it happens, applied only after your approval, logged with the value before and after, and undone in one click. Facts only you know, like a GTIN, are asked for, never made up.

prove.d: Orders that came from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude or Copilot, read from WooCommerce order attribution. Fixed findings are re-checked at once, and AI answers again after 7, 14 and 30 days.

landing.loopText: Including 13 critical issues fixed in one change. A finding is marked resolved only when the same check passes again.
landing.loopNote: Case study: our own test store, not a customer. Your numbers will differ.
landing.honestIntro: Every number has a label, so you know how much to trust it:
landing.observed: seen in your store, in your orders or in a real AI answer
landing.heuristic: a rule of thumb, shown as one
landing.unavailable: we could not check it, and say exactly why
landing.honestNote: AI answers are shown as what the model returned on a date, not as facts. Nothing here promises rankings, visibility or sales.

change.a: Not unless you ask. The scan only reads. A fix that writes to the store needs a separate write key or the signed AgentScope plugin, your approval of a preview, and it can be undone.

shopify.a: The free public check works with Shopify stores. The full scan is for WooCommerce today; Shopify is coming.

need.q: What do you need from me?
need.a: A WooCommerce API key with Read permission. It is stored encrypted and never shown again. The plugin is optional, for AI bot visits and referrals.

landing.ctaTitle: See what AI agents see on your store.
